name: Context and compaction
summary: See what fills Claude's working memory and shrink it when it gets full.
what: Everything in a conversation, from instructions to file reads, takes space in Claude's context window. Claude Code shows what uses that space and compacts older parts into a summary when it runs low, so long sessions can keep going.

impact.title: Know what's using space
impact.detail: A breakdown shows memory files, tools and messages.

impact.title: Longer sessions
impact.detail: Compaction summarizes old turns so work can continue.

howItWorks: Run /context for a live breakdown of context use.
Run /compact, optionally with what to focus on, to summarize now.
Compaction also happens automatically near the limit; /autocompact tunes when.
Subagents keep large reads out of the main conversation.

events.note: Available before the first version in the changelog; this is the oldest listed release.
Added /context to inspect what fills the context window.
